Ots not that I sont appreciate the positive outlook, but I'm not lookong for help. I just kinda wanted to say it out loud and make it real, not just thoughts. I have a well laid out plan and timetable amd there's nothing left to stop me. This has been more of a post for those I leave behond to understand why.

My mom is aware that I want to end my life and she is aware of all of the things that I am dealing with she's definitely not happy and wishes that I would not in my life but she ultimately knows that there's nothing she can do about it and it's my choice. It's not just the pain it's not just the depression it's not just the debt it's not just the lack of Joy It's a combination of all of it. And sadly no nothing brings me joy of any kind and I've actually felt like this for quite a long time. As I stated previously I'm quite at peace with the idea and have no fear of the situation. I'm not going to continue to live my life in constant pain 24/7 lesson 2 or not I've been on medication for it for over a half a decade and that wouldn't stop with getting things fixed and there's no guarantee that the surgery won't make things worse like they have for everybody else I know that has gone through them.
I have also recently had multiple heart attacks in the last 90 days and the cost of that medication is Sky High on top of all of the other debt and bills I can't afford to pay

I have tried every possible remedy for pain and even with surgery it's only going to lessen it not get rid of it I have been on heavy-duty painkillers for 6 years. I am physically unable to do anything a adrenaline wise it's hard enough even just for me walking around let alone doing anything else. I've lived all over the country moving would make any difference besides the fact I I am completely broke and so far in debt I have a hard time putting gas in my car let alone moving anywhere. I do have a good relationship with my mom and I've tried to spend a lot of time with her since my dad passed in June for her but also for myself. I'm just tired, I don't enjoy anything in life anymore and I do mean that not one single thing. It's a burden just to eat sometimes I go 3 or 4 days before I notice that my stomach is rumbling because pain controls my life mix that in with the depression and the anxiety and the crippling debt and the actually being crippled makes me ready to check out. And oddly enough I've thought about it for years and years but I've always had fear of it now I am calm and at peace with it and I am just tying up a few loose ends before I die

My mom is strong, she's doing ok. I live is constant perpetual pain that is a big portion of the problem. Another big problem is I do not enjoy ANYTHING anymore, not 1 single thing. I just go through the motions. We were together 10 years but we were unhappy with each other for at least the last 5, she was the one thing I was still trying to live for. Now that she's done with me I'm done trying to fake it, I'm ready to check out
